mapper.select: select count(*) from cart where POP_ID = #{popId} and MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

select c.CART_ID, c.member_id, p.PRODUCT_TITLE, po.OPTION_NAME, po.OPTION_PRICE, c.QTY,OPTION_PRICE * c.QTY as total_price, pi.PRODUCT_IMAGE_SAVE_NAME as title_image from cart c join OPTIONDETAIL od on od.POP_ID = c.POP_ID join PRODUCTOPTION po on po.OPTION_ID = od.OPTION_ID join product p on p.product_id = od.product_id left join productimage pi on p.PRODUCT_ID = pi.PRODUCT_ID where pi.PRODUCT_TITLE_IMAGE = 0 and c.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.delete: delete from cart where member_id = #{memberId} and POP_ID = #{popId}
